config.selection: Choose trained encoder learning rate by development macro boundary F1 pooled equally across languages; exact ties prefer the smaller learning rate. Record whether it beats the repaired fixed encoder on development. No test-driven choice or tuning.
config.protocol: Exploratory follow-up on already inspected PUD. One fixed document test fold and its next development fold, three nested training-document budgets, three initialization seeds, fixed eight epochs. Compare the historical fixed encoder optimizer, repaired fixed encoder optimizer, and repaired supervised encoder selected from a predeclared development-only learning-rate grid. Evaluate direct decoding, explicit legacy EFE, shared-posterior risk, and development-calibrated risk on the same fitted models. This is not new independent-corpus confirmation or an official CoNLL score.

sources.tokenization: UD surface tokens (MWT rows replace components); whitespace gaps are separate exact spans

partition.limitations: Parallel translated text; custom grouped CV, not the official CoNLL test. No semantic near-duplicate detection beyond source-document/translation IDs and normalized exact text.
